name: Sybelle
source:
Headmistress of the magic school, Sybelle is one of the most powerful witches in the world despite her young age. That may seem like a good deal, but the workload is something she could live without. Whenever the chance to take a vacation comes around, Sybelle jumps on it wholeheartedly.
